_comment: Tolerances for `baseline.py compare`. Set from measured data on 2026-10-01; see README.md 'Tolerances'. Changing a tolerance is like re-baselining: it needs a maintainer's explicit approval, and agents must not loosen it to make a compare pass.

exact._why: Same machine, same GPU driver. Measured: 60/60 renders bit-identical run to run, and 60/60 bit-identical between the daily build and stock 1.6.4. Any difference here is a real change.

cross-environment._why: PROVISIONAL, not yet measured: for a different GPU, driver or machine, where float rounding may legitimately differ. Chosen to fail every one of the 20 smallest-intended-change probes (exposure +0.02, temperature +1, contrast +1, sharpness +5 on 5 raws; smallest signals: mean_abs 24, PSNR 60.4 dB, dE00 mean 0.017) on at least two criteria each, while allowing sparse rounding differences. Re-derive from data the first time a second environment is rendered.
